description: 天兵腿甲与靴子加宽，腰腿按自身髋点和身高相连；巡逻可自主跳过稳定窄坑，无法跨越时掉头走开。
method: Isolated browser context. Real fixed-step game simulation and original 620–680 gap used for autonomous jump/landing; custom 180-wide ledge and 160-wide unsafe gap used for two patrol turns over 210 frames. Avatar hidden with existing camo power so no live target directs the guard. QA hooks not saved in production.
